text: This dual-axis combination chart illustrates executive compensation metrics alongside Total Shareholder Return (TSR) for the years 2015 through 2019. The left vertical axis measures compensation in U.S. dollars up to $10,000,000, represented by grouped bar graphs showing Realized Compensation, Realizable Compensation, and Value of Compensation for each year. The right vertical axis tracks TSR index values using a green line overlay, which trends upward from 2015 to a peak in 2017 before dipping in 2018 and making a slight recovery in 2019.

This image is a line chart titled "Total Return Performance" that compares the cumulative total return of Umpqua Holdings Corporation against the KRX (KBW Regional Bank Index). The vertical axis represents the "Index Value," while the horizontal axis covers five annual time periods from December 31, 2014, to December 31, 2019. Starting at an identical baseline index value of 100 in late 2014, both entities generally trend upward through 2017, undergo a dip in late 2018, and rebound in 2019, with the KRX index consistently maintaining a higher performance level than Umpqua Holdings throughout the entire post-2014 period.

This is a bar chart titled "Total Return Performance" that compares the performance of Umpqua against the KBW Regional Banking Index (KRX). The horizontal axis covers four time horizons—1 year, 3 year, 5 year, and 10 year—while the vertical axis measures total return percentages from 0.0% to 250.0%. Overall, while total returns remain low across the 1-year and 3-year intervals, both categories experience significant growth over the 5-year and 10-year periods, with the KRX index noticeably outperforming Umpqua over the longer terms.
